extracted.name: Fudge Brownies
extracted.description: These fudge brownies are perfectly moist on the inside and filled with fudge in every bite. Neither cakey nor dry, they pair perfectly with a cold glass of milk to help balance the sweetness. 👨🏻‍🍳🍫
ingredient_lines: 3 large eggs + 1 extra yolk (for extra fudginess)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease or line your 13×9 pan with parchment.
Melt butter, then whisk in sugar until combined.
Add eggs + extra yolk + vanilla, whisk until glossy and slightly thick.
Mix in cocoa powder, salt, baking powder.
Fold in flour just until no dry streaks remain.
Bake 25–32 minutes (start checking at 25 min, toothpick should come out with moist crumbs, not clean).
Cool before slicing (40 minutes on countertop, then preferably 1 hour in the fridge).
